prompt: Could you give me ___ about the ferry to Dover?
explanation_ru: Существительное information неисчисляемое, поэтому с ним нельзя употреблять артикль a/an, форму множественного числа или a few; в просьбе подходит some information.

prompt: How (much / many) luggage can we take onto the coach?
explanation_ru: Слово luggage неисчисляемое, поэтому в вопросе о количестве нужно выбрать much, а не many.

prompt: Priya drank three (cup) of strong tea before her shift started.
explanation_ru: Чай (tea) неисчисляемый, но его считают с помощью исчисляемого существительного cup во множественном числе: three cups of tea.

prompt: We picked up two (loaf) of brown bread from the corner shop.
explanation_ru: Хлеб (bread) — неисчисляемое существительное, поэтому его считают буханками; во множественном числе loaf меняется на loaves.

prompt: Thankfully, there (is / are) not too much traffic near the bridge.
explanation_ru: Существительное traffic неисчисляемое, поэтому в конструкции there is/are требуется глагол в единственном числе — is.

prompt: Marek wants to buy ___ grey trousers for his first office shift.
explanation_ru: Слово trousers употребляется только во множественном числе и считается парами (a pair of trousers); a piece of и a little сюда не подходят.

prompt: My uncle bought a lot of old furnitures at the street market.
answer: My uncle bought a lot of old furniture at the street market.
accepted_answers: My uncle bought a lot of old furniture at the street market.
explanation_ru: Существительное furniture в английском неисчисляемое и не имеет окончания -s; типичная ошибка — писать furnitures.

prompt: Would you pass me a (sheet / slice) of paper for my note?
explanation_ru: Неисчисляемую бумагу (paper) считают листами — a sheet of paper, тогда как slice используют для тонких ломтиков еды.

prompt: Our history tutor gave me an advice that saved me two hours of editing.
answer: Our history tutor gave me some advice that saved me two hours of editing.
accepted_answers: Our history tutor gave me some advice that saved me two hours of editing.
Our history tutor gave me a piece of advice that saved me two hours of editing.
Our history tutor gave me advice that saved me two hours of editing.
explanation_ru: Слово advice неисчисляемое, поэтому перед ним нельзя ставить неопределённый артикль an; нужно использовать some advice или a piece of advice.

prompt: Renting our new flat was easy, but we still haven't bought ___ for the sitting room.
explanation_ru: Furniture — неисчисляемое существительное без формы множественного числа и без артикля a; в отрицательном предложении правильно any furniture.

prompt: Sorry, I can't join you for lunch because I have too (much / many) paperwork to finish.
explanation_ru: Существительное paperwork (бумажная работа) неисчисляемое, поэтому после too нужно использовать much.

prompt: For the camping weekend, Yusuf bought six (packet) of noodles and four (tin) of tomato soup.
explanation_ru: Упаковки и банки (packet, tin) — исчисляемые существительные, поэтому после числительных six и four они стоят во множественном числе.

prompt: Sinead ordered five (kilo) of potatoes because eighteen neighbours are coming to her street supper.
explanation_ru: Единица веса kilo — исчисляемое существительное, поэтому после числительного five нужна форма множественного числа kilos.

prompt: Half the guests had to stand because there (wasn't / weren't) enough (chair) in the meeting room.
explanation_ru: Существительное chair исчисляемое, поэтому после enough требуется множественное число chairs и глагол weren't.

prompt: Kofi teaches guitar in the morning and drives a delivery van in the evening. Which sentence describes his situation accurately?
options: Kofi has two works and barely gets a free afternoon.
Kofi has too many work and rarely sees his friends.
Kofi has two jobs and works six days a week.
Kofi has a job and a work at the same time.
explanation_ru: В значении «место работы / должность» используется исчисляемое существительное job (two jobs), а work как род деятельности — неисчисляемое.

prompt: Hi Elena, I'm choosing my university courses and I feel a bit lost. I really need (some / any) (advice) about the first year. I have very (few / little) time left before the Friday deadline. Let me know when you're free to call!
explanation_ru: В утвердительном предложении с неисчисляемым advice употребляется some без окончания -s, а с неисчисляемым time — little.

prompt: Since joining the evening Spanish class, Liam has made ___ in speaking with confidence.
explanation_ru: Слово progress неисчисляемое: с ним нельзя использовать артикль a, множественное число или many/several; правильный вариант — a lot of progress.

prompt: "Sit down, Hannah, I've got two (bit) of news for you!" "Oh dear, (is / are) the news good or bad?" "Relax, both of them are brilliant: we got the flat, and my sister is visiting next month."
explanation_ru: Новости считают с помощью bits of news (после two — bits), но само слово news всегда неисчисляемое и требует глагола is.

prompt: The weather during our autumn cycling holiday in Cornwall was truly terrible. → We had …
answer: We had truly terrible weather during our autumn cycling holiday in Cornwall.
accepted_answers: We had truly terrible weather during our autumn cycling holiday in Cornwall.
We had terrible weather during our autumn cycling holiday in Cornwall.
explanation_ru: Существительное weather неисчисляемое, поэтому перед ним нельзя ставить артикль a даже при наличии прилагательного (terrible weather).

prompt: Dear Farid, thank you for calling me before my interview at the bank. You gave me three (piece) of practical advice that immediately calmed my nerves. Even better, (fewer / less) candidates turned up than expected, so the panel had plenty of time for questions. I will let you know as soon as they reply.
explanation_ru: Советы считают словом piece во множественном числе (three pieces of advice), а с исчисляемым существительным candidates используется fewer, а не less.

prompt: Even though this small farm shop stocks twelve different (kind) of local cheese, there is still very (few / little) room for customers to queue comfortably.
explanation_ru: Сорта неисчисляемого сыра выражаются исчисляемым словом kind во множественном числе (twelve kinds), а room в значении «свободное место» неисчисляемо и требует little.

prompt: Before signing the office lease, Mei noticed one serious gap in the contract. "There are two more (piece) of (information) that we need before we agree," she told the agent. "Has the landlord spent (some / any) money on repairing the broken heating system yet?" The agent promised to send the repair receipts by Friday.
explanation_ru: Сведения считают через pieces of information (без -s у information), а в обычном вопросе о наличии потраченных денег используется any.

prompt: Packing light for a ten-day trip across Scotland took more planning than I expected. I squeezed a small (bar / bottle) of solid soap and a travel (tube / jar) of toothpaste into a clear plastic bag. Thankfully, all of my luggage (was / were) light enough to lift onto the top rack without help. Nothing leaked inside my bag during the entire journey.
explanation_ru: Твёрдое мыло считают кусками (a bar of soap), зубную пасту — тюбиками (a tube of toothpaste), а неисчисляемое luggage согласуется с глаголом was.

prompt: Tomasz visited the winter clearance sale and walked out carrying a wool coat, a scarf, and two warm jumpers. Which sentence summarises his purchase correctly?
options: Tomasz bought four clothings before the winter sale ended.
Tomasz bought four items of clothing during the winter sale.
Tomasz bought four pieces of clothes at the winter sale.
Tomasz bought four clothing and carried them home in one bag.
explanation_ru: Существительное clothing неисчисляемое, поэтому отдельные предметы одежды считают с помощью конструкции items of clothing (four items of clothing).

prompt: Inspectors have gathered a great deal of reliable information about the factory delay, though several key witnesses still refuse to comment.
answer: Inspectors have gathered a great deal of reliable information about the factory delay, though several key witnesses still refuse to comment.
accepted_answers: Inspectors have gathered a great deal of reliable information about the factory delay, though several key witnesses still refuse to comment.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: выражение a great deal of правильно сочетается с неисчисляемым существительным information без окончания -s.

prompt: When Sofia opened the kitchen cupboard after her flight home, she realised she had forgotten to shop before leaving. There (was / were) only a tiny bit of rice in the jar and (fewer / less) milk than she needed for tea. Fortunately, she spotted a couple of (apple) and a fresh loaf of bread, so she didn't go hungry. She promised herself to order a delivery online before her next flight.
explanation_ru: Выражение a tiny bit of rice требует глагола единственного числа was, неисчисляемое milk сочетается с less, а исчисляемое apple после a couple of стоит во множественном числе.

prompt: Despite our rowing club's tight budget, a generous sponsor donated two modern (item / equipment) so that the junior team could train safely.
explanation_ru: Слово equipment неисчисляемое и не принимает -s; чтобы указать количество единиц снаряжения, используют конструкцию two items of equipment.
